articles.summary: AXT, Inc. (NasdaqGS: AXTI), a leading manufacturer of compound semiconductor wafer substrates, today reported financial results for the third quarter, ended September 30, 2026. Management Qualitative Comments “This is a pivotal and exciting period for AXT,” said Morris Young, chief executive officer. “Our revenue in Q3 reached a record $73.4 million, up 54 percent from the prior quarter and up 162 percent year over year, driven by exceptionally strong customer demand for our indium phosphide material. We entered 2026 with a commitment to double our indium phosphide capacity and I am pleased to report that not only have we surpassed that goal but we have more than quadrupled our 2026 indium phosphide revenue opportunity through additional productivity gains and the expansion of our capabilities for high-value, large diameter products. articles.summary: AXT, Inc. (NasdaqGS: AXTI), a leading manufacturer of compound semiconductor substrates, today announced that its majority-owned subsidiary, Beijing Tongmei Xtal Technology Co., Ltd. (“Tongmei”), has entered into definitive agreements for a private equity financing to fund further expansion of its manufacturing capacity for indium phosphide semiconductor substrates, expansion of its principal business operations, capital expenditures and general working capital. articles.title: AXT, Inc. Announces Up to RMB 3.67 Billion (Approximately US$545 Million) in Private Equity Financing for Subsidiary Tongmei

articles.summary: AXT, Inc. (NasdaqGS: AXTI ), a leading manufacturer of compound semiconductor substrates, will announce its financial results for the third quarter 2026 in a press release immediately following the close of market on October 29, 2026. The company will also host a conference call to discuss these results on October 29, 2026 at 1:30 p.m. PT. The conference call can be accessed at (833) 461-5787 (passcode 457551713). The call will also be simulcast at www.axt.com . The webcast will be available at http://www.axt.com until October 29, 2027. Additional investor information can be accessed at http://www.axt.com . About AXT, Inc. AXT is a material science company that develops and manufactures high-performance compound and single element semiconductor substrate wafers comprising indium phosphide (InP), gallium arsenide (GaAs) and germanium (Ge).
